verseText: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us. For it is written: “Cursed is everyone who is hung on a tree.”
meaning: Sin's curse is death. Jesus redeemed us (paid the price to rescue us) from sin's dreadful curse by suffering the curse of death in our place on the cross.
